en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's go to the bathroom
Let's try to find a dirty movie
We should focus on reality, not movies

T-True... It'd be hell if you had to go during
the movie.
Uh...

I can't allow that tragedy to happen
again...
<CLT=cltMIND>...Again!?
Hah! You would say that, ya fuckin' choad!
But think about it for half a second!

You got a busty beauty standin' right here!
A real woman is way better than a fake one!

D-Don't tell me you get off on the fake
shit!

Oh, I was thinkin' the same thing!
Personally, I'm somethin' of a realist!

I mean, the entire world is depending
on my genius inventions!

If I chose movies over reality, reality
would turn into a sobbing mess!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Miu looks deep in thought...
(Hmph...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Miu's inner thoughts...?
